definition.alternative: Preference emergence may be inherently chaotic and non-convergent outside of trivial constraints.
assumptions: Agent learning processes operate via bounded locally-linear updates.
Initial parameter noise significantly affects the specific convergence trajectory.

definition.uncertainty: The precise bounds of the parameter space hyper-volume remain heuristic and require empirical calibration.
